name: ModelVariant448_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant448_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x34-byte config record indexed by the request, gets three slot parts, uploads five texture images and sets up the radial disc, fan, orbit, web, ring, spoke and quad records, otherwise it runs one frame (radial disc from the config start frame, orbit sheets from phase 5, fans from phase 1, tint and fade) and returns 4 in phases 5-6, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md); notes/overlays/model-variants.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant465.md
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound C image; the European, French, German and Italian images build it from french_model_variant/variant465_entry.c with the PAL palette x; the Spanish entry is still assembly. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
